rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for things connected with Christianity.

example.english: There are many Christian holidays that people in Hong Kong celebrate.
example.traditional: 基督教嘅節日好多香港人都會慶祝。
example.jyutping: gei1 duk1 gaau3 ge3 zit3 jat6 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 dou1 wui5 hing3 zuk1

rows.note: Use this when the association is specifically with Christians as people rather than with Christianity as a religion.

example.english: The Christian gathering is usually held on Sunday.
example.traditional: 基督徒嘅聚會通常喺星期日舉行。
example.jyutping: gei1 duk1 tou4 ge3 zeoi6 wui2 tung1 soeng4 hai2 sing1 kei4 jat6 geoi2 hang4

rows.note: Use this specifically for things connected with Jesus Christ.

example.english: The teachings of Jesus Christ are very important to my Christian faith.
example.traditional: 耶穌基督嘅教導對我好重要。
example.jyutping: je4 sou1 gei1 duk1 ge3 gaau3 dou6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 zung6 jiu3
